object.name: seat_manager
object.description: Interface for creating client seat connections.

c2s.name: open_seat
c2s.description: Creates a seat object for the client's current session. The daemon sends either enabled or disabled to indicate the initial seat state.

object.name: seat
object.description: Seat control interface based on libseat. A client opens a seat, reacts to enabled and disabled events, opens device objects while enabled, and may request session switches when supported by the daemon.

s2c.name: enabled

description.summary: seat is active for this client

s2c.description: Sent when the client may open and use seat devices.

s2c.name: disabled

description.summary: seat is inactive for this client

s2c.description: Sent when the client must stop using devices opened through this seat and acknowledge the state change with ack_disabled.

s2c.name: session_switched
s2c.description: Emitted when a session switch has taken effect.

s2c.name: seat_error
s2c.description: Sent before the seat object is terminated after a fatal seat-scoped protocol error.

c2s.name: ack_disabled
c2s.description: Acknowledges the most recent disabled event.

c2s.name: open_device

description.summary: open a device on this seat

c2s.description: Opens path and returns a device object. The returned object resolves exactly once with either opened or failed.

c2s.name: switch_session

description.summary: switch to another session or VT

c2s.description: Requests switching to the given target session. The daemon reports a seat error if switching is not supported.

c2s.name: destroy
c2s.description: Closes the seat and any devices still associated with it.

object.name: device
object.description: Device object created by seat.open_device. It resolves exactly once with either opened or failed. If revoked is emitted, the device is permanently unusable and the client should destroy the object.

value.name: seat_disabled
value.summary: seat was disabled when opening the device
